column2: Long-term benchmark/model/subscription research warehouse with formula-driven decision views.
Dashboard, Contenders, Rankings, Plan_Winners, Winner_Boards, Controls appear first.
Model family, model/effort variant, and benchmark observation/version/date are separate keys.
Do not compare raw versions blindly. Populate Version_Crosswalk with dual-tested variants; aggregate into Version_Pair_Summary and Benchmark_Versions.
Prefer direct identical-variant ratios. Use robust median/mean + stdev across many bridges; chain versions only when no direct bridge exists.
AA Intelligence Index v4.3.2 snapshots through 2026-10-17; CAI v1.5 rows checked through 2026-10-16. Test dates remain unknown where not published.
usable_surplus = levelled_score − (target−1). Models below target are excluded from threshold value ratios.
Balanced/smart/speed value scores are multiplicative so a model cannot fully hide a failed axis with one excellent axis.
OpenCode dollar caps are direct spend-equivalent caps. Prompt/message plans are AA-task spend proxies. Relative-only plans remain unpriced.
Macro-free: choose Default + clear overrides to reset; copy a profile row to save; Config_History records build defaults.
usable_units = levelled_score − (target−1). A score below target produces <=0 and is excluded; a score exactly at target has 1 usable unit, avoiding divide-by-zero while preserving the pass/fail bar.

Benchmark_Followups is the durable queue. Recheck every OPEN row on each scheduled AInventory maintenance run; update last_checked_date/result; keep OPEN until closure criteria are verified and evidence URLs are recorded.

Release_Review records candidates, scope decisions, source lineage and exclusions for the current 30-day window. Do not rank preview/restricted/audio/TTS endpoints with an incomparable text benchmark.
Qualitative_Assessments stores editorial judgments separately from benchmark facts. Blank ratings mean not assessed; vendor claims do not justify independent 1–5 scores.
A snapshot_date records when a public source page was observed; test_run_date remains blank when the benchmark run date is not disclosed. Never substitute snapshot date as the test date.

Chart_Data_Reviewed contains all 49 chart records and explicit source dates. Workbook raw observations append only; current same-day snapshots retain original precision. Historical snapshots are not independent experimental replicates. Subscription lookups now select latest matching family/effort snapshot.

Added 25 public variant rows observed 2026-10-16, including component scores, agent harness, task cost, wall time, token usage, benchmark version, and row-level source links. Test execution dates were not disclosed; snapshot_date is not test_run_date.

AA Intelligence Index v4.3.2 and Coding Agent Index v1.5 are separate composites, each with a score near 0–100. The CAI is the equal-weight mean of DeepSWE v1.1 (113 tasks), Terminal-Bench 4.0 (66), and SWE-Atlas-QnA (124). No cross-index score-level factor is applied.

AA Index time is weighted decode seconds per Intelligence Index task, excluding TTFT and overhead. CAI time is average agent wall time per coding task, involving multi-step software tasks and an agent harness. CAI task time includes task-runtime telemetry where available; it is not the same workload or grain.

Benchmark_Comparison independently selects AA or CAI score, timing, and cost. Bubble size grows as the selected timing value gets shorter. Select the AA or CAI cost source to keep the displayed task cost aligned with its benchmark.

22 paired model/effort rows across 10 families: Pearson r=0.935, Spearman rho=0.924. A descriptive OLS fit gives CAI ≈ -13.96 + 1.455×AA; an AA score of 45 maps to about 51.5 on this snapshot. Leave-one-family-out RMSE was 5.8 CAI points. Repeated effort rows are clustered within model families; this is not a score conversion.

20 paired rows with both current AA decode time and CAI time: Pearson r=0.779, Spearman rho=0.894. Median CAI/AA time ratio 4.52× (range 2.19×–12.66×). The comparison joins different tasks and harnesses; never apply a universal minute multiplier.

Coding_Agent_Lookups records online checks. No public result was found for MiMo-V2.6 Pro/Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, GPT-6.1 Astra/Terra, or exact DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Older DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 and GPT-6 Astra rows remain separately named.
CAI cost is pay-per-token API cost per coding-agent task. Muse Wonder Full showed $0.00 with “Comparison not available”; numeric CAI cost remains blank and is not interpreted as free.

Added current AA v4.3.2 snapshots for Gemini 3.8 Flash Low/Medium/High and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. Gemini 3.1 AA effort remains not stated; Gemini 4 Argon Low is API-supported but unscored. Gemini 3.5 Flash is retained only as a deprecated historical workbook row.

See sources/gemini-refresh-2026-10-17.json for dated values, source URLs, missing-field checks, and source notes. The direct AA model page is authoritative for current summary metrics; conflicting live comparison-page timing values remain unimported.
